BEFORE THE DISPUTE

We are hired before the dispute — and we are the reason it does not become one.

When it happens anyway, we are already in the room, and we already know the file.

How we work ↗

THE COST OF WAITING

Conflict does not get expensive gradually.
It steps.

Every step is a door closing — a decision that could have been made in a week instead taking a year, a relationship that survives becoming one that does not. Most dispute professionals are hired at the fourth step. We would rather be hired at the first.

COST · TIME · RELATIONSHIP DAMAGE
